blocks.text: Action potentials ki taqat (amplitude) axon ki poori lambai mein ek jaisi rehti hai. Axon ke aakhir ka action potential utna hi taqatwar hota hai jitna pehla. Lekin nerve impulse ki raftar (velocity), yaani action potential ke aage barhne ki raftar, badal sakti hai. Agar axon ka qutr (diameter) bara ho ya axon myelinated ho to raftar zyada hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Myelinated axon ke do lamhe. Schwann cells (myelin) axon ko dhanpe hain aur un ke darmiyan khali jagahein (nodes) hain. Upar wali qataar mein action potential (ulte charges) pehle node par hai; mura hua teer agle node par chhalang lagata hai, jahan neeche wali qataar mein action potential hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Myelin (Schwann cells) ke neeche ions aa ja nahin sakte, is liye action potential sirf nodes of Ranvier par banta hai. Upar wali qataar mein woh pehle node par hai; teer dikhata hai ke agla action potential seedha agle node par banta hai (neeche wali qataar). Is chhalang (saltatory conduction) ki wajah se myelinated axon mein impulse bohat tez chalta hai.

Myelinated axons mein action potentials sirf nodes of Ranvier par bante hain. Yeh action potentials myelin wale hisson ko chhor kar ek node se doosre node par chhalang lagate hain. Ise nerve impulse ki saltatory conduction (chhalang wali conduction) kehte hain. Yeh sab se tez non-myelinated axons ke impulse se bhi 50 guna tak tez hai. Insan mein non-myelinated neurons 1 se 3 meter fi second ki raftar se impulse le jate hain, jabke myelinated neurons 120 meter fi second tak ki raftar se.

blocks.prompt: Neuron 'a' mein impulses neuron 'b' se tez chalte hain. Do mumkina wajahein batayein.
blocks.explanation: Neuron 'a' myelinated hai (saltatory conduction), ya us ke axon ka diameter 'b' se bara hai.

items: Amplitude poori lambai mein ek jaisa; raftar myelin ya bare diameter se zyada. Saltatory conduction: node se node chhalang, 50 guna tak tez; non-myelinated 1 se 3 m/s, myelinated 120 m/s tak.
